name: OBJ Adventures Nhulunbuy
summary: Fishing charters from Nhulunbuy on the Gove Peninsula in East Arnhem Land, run by a family business that describes itself as Aboriginal owned and operated. Half day, full day, offshore and island charters leave at 7am and take up to 8 anglers, with all fishing gear provided. A sunset harbour cruise and private charters are also offered.
standouts: Aboriginal owned and operated, family-owned business
Winner of the NT Chamber of Commerce Excellence in Business award for Manufacturing and Marine Industries (Small Business) in 2023, 2024 and 2025
Finalist in the 2025 Australian Small Business Champion Awards
Says it uses electric motors to reduce emissions, recycles, and uses water jugs to cut single-use plastic

trips.title: Half Day Fishing Charter Nhulunbuy
trips.summary: A half day fishing charter from Nhulunbuy, leaving the Melville Bay Road boat ramp at 7am for up to 4 hours on the water. All bait, tackle and rods are provided. You bring your own snacks and drinks.
highlights: Leaves at 7am, up to 4 hours on the water
All fishing gear provided (bait, tackle, rods)
Optional pickup from the Boat Club on request, tide dependent
Needs a minimum of 4 anglers to run, up to 8 on the boat
trips.duration: up to 4 hours on the water
trips.departsFrom: Melville Bay Road boat ramp, Nhulunbuy
includes: Eskies to store food and drinks
bring: Optional: your own fishing rod or lure (tell the crew beforehand so there is room)
Alcohol may be brought on board, cans preferred; a permit is needed to buy takeaway alcohol in Nhulunbuy
trips.requirements: Children are welcome if over the age of 5 and under parental supervision at all times. A minimum of 4 anglers is needed to run a charter, and the boat takes up to 8.
trips.checkNotes: Price, departure and booking link are from the Charters page, where the Book Now button for this charter carries the Rezdy link. The home page card says '4 hours departing 7am' and the Charters page says 'up to 4 hours on the water'; used the Charters wording. Currency is not stated, only '$350 per person'; recorded as AUD. Minimum and maximum anglers, the age rule, eskies and alcohol come from the FAQ and are written for the fishing charters in general. The FAQ also says a single angler cannot book online and has to contact the operator to be matched with a running charter, so the Rezdy listing may not allow fewer than 4 (not opened). No season stated.
